title: Claude Code: Desktop application
summary: The Desktop app's Code tab is built from panes you arrange: chat, Changes, Browser, Terminal, Files, Plan, Background tasks, subagent output, and a session rail of cards (Environment, Changes, what is running, Context). It lists sessions in a sidebar and sends an OS notification when a session finishes. Mods draw here (from v2.1.286) in local sessions. Projects open here too. Only the first 100,000 of about 209,000 characters were read.
ideas: The Desktop Code tab on Samuel's Mac is the place where a mod's pane and Projects both appear.
Notifications already tell Samuel when a session finishes.
